scope: Unique fictional characters across a large catalog, e.g. 100 series
reference: U.S. Census Bureau national population estimates, Vintage 2025
guidance: Approximate U.S. racial/ethnic population proportions over the catalog. Each individual cast should fit its setting, relationships and family resemblance. Age-25 default and role-specific age exceptions are separate creative choices.
classification: Track explicitly authored character backgrounds; do not infer race/ethnicity from portraits. Keep race and Hispanic ethnicity separate, or use an explicitly defined mutually exclusive combined table. Unknown/unassigned backgrounds remain separate.
implementation_status: User preference and source recorded. Automated catalog demographic tracking/targets are not yet implemented; no percentages guessed from current cast images.
